question: What procedure holds for the hidden form and the body-pot shining?
premises: But that very one of hidden form, toward pure-part self-consciousness.
Thence the body-pot shining; therein too this very procedure.
inference: Hidden-form consciousness and body-pot shining share one procedure.
plain_english: But that very one of hidden form — toward pure-part self-consciousness; thence the body-pot shining; therein too this very procedure.
